title: Silence and Weather
author: M. M. Delacroix
blurb: Astrid Yarrow, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
